description: For fixed partial initial and step functions, exactly one partial function satisfies their strict primitive-recursion equations.
signature:
Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.PartialRecursiveFunctions.recursion_unique {k : ℕ}
  (g : Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.PartialRecursiveFunctions.PFunction k)
  (h : Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.PartialRecursiveFunctions.PFunction (k + 2))
  (r : Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.PartialRecursiveFunctions.PFunction (k + 1))
  (hz :
    ∀ (x : Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.PartialRecursiveFunctions.Args k),
      r (Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.PartialRecursiveFunctions.snoc x 0) = g x)
  (hs :
    ∀ (x : Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.PartialRecursiveFunctions.Args k) (n : ℕ),
      r (Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.PartialRecursiveFunctions.snoc x (n + 1)) =
        (r (Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.PartialRecursiveFunctions.snoc x n)).bind fun a =>
          h
            (Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.PartialRecursiveFunctions.snoc
              (Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.PartialRecursiveFunctions.snoc x n) a)) :
  r = Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.PartialRecursiveFunctions.partialRec g h
